---
title: "Women's College Volleyball Roster Cleaning — Quality Report"
params:
  season: "2026-27"
execute:
  echo: false
---

This report renders the build's outputs for the selected season. It reads and
audits the files `scripts/build_rosters.R` produces; it does not re-implement
transformations. Set the season with `params$season` (a full academic-year
label such as `2026-27`), e.g.:

```r
rmarkdown::render("analysis/cleaning.qmd", params = list(season = "2026-27"))
```

The canonical season label drives everything; the build processed seasons
chronologically so backfilled high schools come from the previous season's
corrected output.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Paths are repo-relative; render from the repository root wherever run.
root_dir <- getwd()
if (!file.exists(file.path(root_dir, "data", "reference", "raw_snapshots.csv"))) {
  # likely invoked with analysis/ as the working directory
  root_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "..")
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root_dir)
library(tidyverse)

SEASON <- params$season

clean_file <- function(kind) {
  switch(kind,
    clean    = file.path("data", "clean", paste0("vb_rosters_", SEASON, ".csv")),
    baseline = file.path("data", "derived", "baseline", paste0("vb_rosters_", SEASON, ".csv")),
    quarantine = file.path("data", "derived", "quarantine", paste0("vb_rosters_", SEASON, ".csv")))
}

audits_dir <- file.path("data", "derived", "audits", SEASON)

read_audit <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(audits_dir, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(tibble())
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = "")
}
read_output <- function(kind) {
  path <- clean_file(kind)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("build output missing: ", path)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, na = "")
}

if (!file.exists(clean_file("clean"))) {
  stop("No build output for ", SEASON, ". Run scripts/build_rosters.R --season ",
       SEASON, " first.")
}

vb_rosters <- read_output("clean")
baseline   <- read_output("baseline")
quarantine <- read_output("quarantine")

issues      <- read_audit("row_issues.csv")
dup_review  <- read_audit("duplicate_review.csv")
coverage    <- read_audit("team_coverage.csv")
quality     <- read_audit("quality_summary.csv")
reconciled  <- read_audit("reconciliation.csv")

n_clean <- nrow(vb_rosters)
```

## Reconciliation

Raw rows must equal the sum of published, quarantined, duplicate-removal and
reviewed-exclusion rows. The build enforces this before writing anything.

```{r reconciliation}
reconciled
stopifnot(sum(reconciled$rows) == nrow(baseline))
```

## Quality summary

```{r quality}
quality |>
  mutate(display = paste0(metric, ": ", value))
```

`*_rate_pct` metrics are shares of non-missing raw values; `high_school_`
metrics count published rows.

## Quarantined rows

Structural problems quarantine the individual row with a reason. Every raw
value is preserved in `data/derived/quarantine/`.

```{r quarantine-reasons}
quarantine |>
  count(quarantine_reason, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r quarantine-teams}
if (nrow(quarantine)) {
  quarantine |>
    count(ncaa_id, team, sort = TRUE) |>
    head(20)
}
```

## Field-level warnings (published rows)

A bad field does not prove the row is not a player, so these rows publish
with an explicit status. The unparsable raw values should shrink to genuine
unknowns over time.

```{r parse-failures}
vb_rosters |>
  filter(!is.na(height_raw) & str_squish(height_raw) != "", is.na(total_inches)) |>
  count(height_raw, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r position-failures}
vb_rosters |>
  filter(!is.na(position_raw) & str_squish(position_raw) != "", is.na(position_clean)) |>
  count(position_raw, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r class-failures}
vb_rosters |>
  filter(!is.na(year_raw) & str_squish(year_raw) != "", is.na(year_clean)) |>
  count(year_raw, sort = TRUE)
```

## Unrecognized geography

Only dictionary hits resolve; cities, club names and majors are never
promoted to a country. Anything here is a candidate for
`data/reference/country_variants.csv` / `state_variants.csv` — or a genuine
unknown.

```{r geography-failures}
if (any(vb_rosters$hometown_status == "unparsed")) {
  vb_rosters |> filter(hometown_status == "unparsed") |> count(team, sort = TRUE)
}
```

## Duplicate review

Candidate groups share a profile URL, player ID, or normalized name within a
team-season. Matching name/jersey is evidence, not proof: rows collapse only
through reviewed `corrections/row_corrections.csv` entries, and everything
else is quarantined.

```{r duplicate-review}
if (nrow(dup_review)) {
  dup_review
} else {
  tibble(note = "no candidate duplicate groups this season")
}
```

## Team coverage

Raw, published, quarantined, duplicate and excluded counts by team.
Teams that had raw rows but published nothing are build blockers unless
reviewed in `data/reference/coverage_exceptions.csv`.

```{r coverage}
coverage |>
  filter(rows_raw > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(rows_raw - published)) |>
  head(20)
```

```{r coverage-empty}
coverage |> filter(rows_raw > 0, published == 0)
```

## Roster sizes and staleness

```{r roster-sizes}
vb_rosters |>
  count(division, team, name = "players") |>
  group_by(division) |>
  summarise(teams = n(), min = min(players), median = median(players),
            max = max(players), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r missing-class-years}
no_year <- vb_rosters |>
  group_by(ncaa_id, team) |>
  summarise(players = n(), no_year = sum(is.na(year_clean)), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(no_year == players)
if (nrow(no_year)) no_year else tibble(note = "every team has at least one class year")
```

## Provenance notes

```{r corrections}
# reviewed corrections that touched this season's rows
corrections_file <- "corrections/cell_corrections.csv"
if (file.exists(corrections_file)) {
  corrows <- read_csv(corrections_file, show_col_types = FALSE, na = "")
  corrows |>
    mutate(snapshot = str_remove(source_row_id, "#.*$")) |>
    filter(snapshot == paste0(SEASON, "_1")) |>
    count(field, sort = TRUE)
}
```

Stale-roster flags (shared profile URLs plus identical names/classes) live in
the build summary; removing a flagged team-season requires a reviewed entry
in `data/reference/source_exclusions.csv`.
